description: This Swift source file defines a singleton class KeychainStore that provides an interface for securely storing, retrieving, and deleting sensitive string data (such as tokens) from the iOS Keychain service. It encapsulates common keychain operations such as adding, fetching, and removing items, and manages keys via an internal enum.

classes.name: KeychainStore
classes.description: A singleton class providing a secure interface to store, retrieve, and delete string data in the iOS Keychain.

methods.name: setString
methods.description: Stores a string securely in the Keychain for a specified key, encoding it as UTF-8 data.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string from the Keychain for a specified key, decoding it from UTF-8 data.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific key-value pair from the Keychain.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all app entries related to the predefined keys from the Keychain.
